test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question: The price of an electronic machine decreased by 5%, 10% and 15% during the first three years. What will be the price of the machine after three years if the value at the beginning was ₹ 8,000?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial price of the machine = ₹8,000

Price decrease percentages over three years:

Year 1: 5%

Year 2: 10%

Year 3: 15%

**Formula used:**

Price after each year = Current price × (1 - Rate of decrease)
